title: UpdateShellPreferencesRequest
description: Body of PATCH /api/users/me/preferences (HEL-1574, HEL-1572, HEL-1575): any non-empty subset of the shell keys (contextListWidth, contextListCollapsed), appearance keys (typeStyle, density, motion) and `dashboardTabs` (replaces the stored tab set as a whole: at most 20 tabs, unique non-empty ids of at most 64 characters, `activeId` null or one of the tab ids); unknown fields and out-of-range/unknown values are rejected with 400. Only the fields present are stored. `motion: null` removes the saved motion choice so the user follows the OS reduce-motion setting again. HEL-1755: `assistantModel: null` removes the saved default model.

assistantModel.description: HEL-1755: a selectable catalog id sets the default assistant model for new conversations (any other string is a 400); null removes it so new conversations use the server default.
